name: A11y Accessibility Enhancer for WCAG and ADA
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
🌟 A11y Accessibility Enhancer is a free, powerful WordPress plugin that makes your website inclusive and compliant with WCAG 2.1/2.2 and ADA standards. Its intuitive, floating widget empowers users to adjust font sizes, contrast modes, enable text-to-speech, and apply vision profiles—no coding needed! Ideal for bloggers, businesses, and agencies, it enhances SEO, broadens your audience, and mitigates accessibility-related legal risks.

Key Free Features:
– Dynamic Widget: Icon-driven panel with 36 languages (English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Chinese Simplified, Hindi, etc.). Auto-translates with flag selector.
– Vision Tools:
– Font size (4 levels: small, medium, large, extra-large).
– High contrast (4 levels: light, dark, inverted, enhanced).
– Grayscale (4 levels: mild to full desaturation).
– Link underlining/highlighting for clarity.
– Letter spacing (4 levels: tight, normal, wide, extra-wide).
– Text-to-Speech: Native browser reader for selected or full-page text, ideal for low-vision users.
– Vision Profiles: Deuteranomaly, Protanomaly, Tritanomaly, Blindness, Epilepsy-Safe, Dyslexia-Friendly modes.
– Navigation Aids:
– Reduce motion for animation sensitivity.
– Pause animations/GIFs.
– Large cursor for easier navigation.
– Visible focus for keyboard users.
– Simplified layout (hides non-essential media).
– Customization:
– Widget position (bottom-right/left).
– Styling: Colors (header, footer, text, icons), font family/size, border radius, padding, shadow, button size.
– Toggle icon: Universal access or wheelchair (Pro: custom icons).
– Admin Dashboard: Tabs for General (OpenAI key, custom CSS), Styles, Widget Features, AI Alt Text (teaser), Color Contrast (Pro), WCAG Report (alt text only in free).
– Multi-Language: On-the-fly translation with RTL support for Arabic/Hebrew.
– Performance & Privacy: Lightweight (<50KB JS/CSS), no external dependencies beyond Font Awesome, GDPR-friendly with local storage.

Why Choose A11y Enhancer?
– 🚀 20+ free features rival premium plugins.
– ♿ Supports WCAG criteria (1.4.3 contrast, 1.4.10 reflow, 1.4.12 text spacing).
– 📱 Mobile-responsive, theme-agnostic (works with Elementor, Gutenberg, etc.).
– 🔒 No tracking or cookies beyond user preferences.
– 🌍 Global reach with 36 languages and vision simulations.
– 💡 SEO boost: Accessible sites rank higher on Google.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the a11y-enhancer folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Customize in Settings > A11y Enhancer (tabs for styles, features, etc.).
  4. Widget appears on frontend—test and adjust!
sections.faq:
Which languages are supported?

36 languages (English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Hindi, etc.) with auto-translation and RTL support for Arabic/Hebrew.

Does it ensure WCAG/ADA compliance?

It supports compliance (e.g., contrast, reflow, text spacing), but manual audits are needed for full adherence. Use the WCAG report for insights.

How customizable is the widget?

Adjust position, colors, fonts, and features. Pro adds custom icons and advanced styling (borders, hovers).

Is text-to-speech browser-dependent?

Yes, uses native APIs (e.g., SpeechSynthesis in Chrome/Firefox). Best on modern browsers.

Can I reset settings?

Yes, via the widget’s reset button or admin dashboard defaults.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, theme-agnostic and tested with Elementor, Gutenberg, and more.

What’s the performance impact?

Minimal: Lightweight JS/CSS (<50KB), no database queries beyond settings.
